question: What a load draws on the AI's generator before its first hour, and how that generator is seeded.

addresses.name: ProcessAI
addresses.comment: **One country's whole AI pass**, read whole on the listing (rva 0x4894E0 to the `ret 4` at 0x489BB5; two earlier `ret 4` exits at 0x489618 and 0x48986A with the body continuing past them - trap 3). In order: (1) nothing while `ai +0x128` (ai_paused, the console's AI pause) or the country's theatres_dirty (CCountry +0x580) is set; (2) the played country (`ai->id == gamestate->player`) has runs_units (+0x2C) cleared; (3) CEU3AI_RefreshUnitDestinations (0x49A800), AI_ManageUndergrounds (0x489E10); (4) a country owning no province and not in exile: CEU3AI_SendLandlessUnitsOnExpedition (0x499A10) and return; (5) firstPass = unit_pass_done (+0xA5) clear - but in a game loaded from a save (gamestate +0xD9C) firstPass is false and theatres_changed (+0xA6) is cleared; (6) every enabled minister on +0x74 is ticked (slot 9) and the foreign minister answers its offers (0x49E010); (7) the played country with automation[6] == 1: DeployFinishedUnits (0x48B300), every hour; (8) the played country of a loaded game with runs_units clear and no unit agent yet: CreateAgentsForPlannedUnits (0x48BEF0); (9) CEU3AI_DisbandTheatrelessHQs (0x489BD0) - a true answer ends the pass; (10) while theatres_changed is set, the strategy's theatres (CCountry +0x570, which is CAIStrategy +0xE4) are walked: the first whose `unit` does not resolve sends the pass on to (11); when every one resolves, CEU3AI_SortUnitsIntoTheatres(ai, isPlayer) - every unit put under the headquarters of the theatre it stands in, by posted detach and attach commands (FINDINGS-agents.md G) - theatres_changed cleared and **return**, so that hour ticks no agent; (11) every unit agent (+0x40) and every invasion agent (+0x50) is ticked through slot 9. Then with hour = (tick - 43800000) % 24 and the country id: (12) at hour 1 of the 1st of a month the failed-invasion areas (+0x94) are freed; at hour id%24 CEU3AI_AssignSeaTargetsToAgents (0x48C140); always CEU3AI_PruneInvasions (0x491BE0) into a local list; (13) a country whose runs_units is clear (the played one): on even hours, for each unit agent CEU3AI_RankInvasionAreas (0x495530) and CEU3AI::PlanAmphibiousInvasion (0x492190) with that agent - and nothing more; (14) every other country: CEU3AI_RecallStrandedLandUnits (0x498870) on the first pass or at hour (id+16)%24; CEU3AI::CreateAgentsForTheatres (0x48AA80); CEU3AI_BindAgentsAndAttachOrphans (0x48DCF0, whose answer is always false); at hour id%24 CEU3AI_ChoosePride (0x499C80), CEU3AI_BalanceDivisionsBetweenTheatres (0x48E490) where unit_pass_done is set, CEU3AI::RebuildPriorityProvinces (0x4976E0), RankInvasionAreas(ai, null), CEU3AI_RebuildWeakEnemyPorts (0x4972E0), CEU3AI::GenerateUnitObjectives (0x4980E0), PlanAmphibiousInvasion(ai, list, null); else at hour (id+8)%24 CEU3AI_GatherTransportsForTheatres (0x490DB0), DeployFinishedUnits, AI_ReassignLeaders (0x498EF0); else at hour (id+16)%24 every unit agent's per-type tally (CAIUnit +0x23C) zeroed, CEU3AI_DistributeFleetsToTheatres (0x48FBB0), CEU3AI_DistributeAirToTheatres (0x48F2B0), and CEU3AI_PromoteLeadersForCommands (0x499280); then CEU3AI::UpdateUnitStances(ai, hour == (id+16)%24) and unit_pass_done = 1. Callers: RunAIPass's tbb parallel_for, once a game hour from the frame after the hour turns; CInGameIdler::Enter for a game loaded from a save; a once-per-process multiplayer kick; idler slot 67 (FINDINGS-ai.md). **A single-player new game runs none of it during its two days and first hour.** See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-agents.md, section A. **A game just loaded runs two passes for every country at its own hour, before its first hour** (counted in the running game on a save of July 1941, 2026-11-10: 204 passes for 102 countries, all at the save's tick, agent ticks 192 for 96 agents, land blocks 96). Every agent is already there when the first pass begins; unit_pass_done reads 0 and theatres_changed 1 on the first pass and 1 and 0 on the second. Which of the two runs the land block was not logged. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 12. **Each of a load's two passes is a country's whole pass, its ministers ticked in both** (recorded on the running game, 2026-11-16, FINDINGS-liveread.md section 106): the first on the main thread, all 102 countries in the list's order, the second on the worker threads; a minister whose countdown runs out in either and whose hour of the day is the save's works there - at 07:00 on 16 July 1941 Holland's foreign minister (CAIForeignMinister::ExecuteDiploDecisions' scope draw and six of the Lua's `math.random`) and Greece's politics minister (four CCurrentGameState_GetAIRand), both in the second pass, the AI generator's draws 505 to 509.
addresses.evidence: hoidraws.lua armed from the main menu through the load of Ireland1941_07_16_07 and entering: 204 ProcessAI entries at the save's tick, the first 102 on one stack (the main thread's, in list order), the second 102 on about a dozen worker stacks; draws 505-508 at 0x4E99E4 (CCurrentGameState_GetAIRand) on Greece's worker stack, 509 at 0x49DE12 (ExecuteDiploDecisions) and six math.random values 41, 18467, 6334, 26500, 19169, 15724 (a fresh thread's rand()) on Holland's. Holland is 18th in the list, (18 + 13) % 24 = 7, the foreign minister's hour; Greece 38th, (38 + 17) % 24 = 7, the politics minister's.
addresses.revises: comment - a load's two passes run the ministers, the first on the main thread in list order

addresses.name: CEU3AI::CreateMinisters
addresses.comment: **Creates or destroys the five ministers, and the whole AI-delegation rule is here.** Bare `ret`, one caller: the tail of CEU3AI::CEU3AI at 0x888566. For each ministry: return outright when `gamestate[+0xD0C] != 0`; create unconditionally when this is not the played country (`this[+0x24] != gamestate[+0xC34]`); and when it is, create only when the local player delegates it, else destroy. So **an AI country always has all five, and the human's country has only the ones delegated**. The player's tests: foreign `GetLocalPlayer()[+0x38][0] == 1` (+0x60), production `[1]` (+0x64), espionage `[4]` (+0x68), politics `[3]` (+0x70) - **but the tech minister (+0x6C) is made when `GetLocalPlayer()[+0x30] != 0`**, the four-way value the save calls `automate_tech_sliders`, and for the player only its two bytes are then set from it: 1 gives vbSliders and vbResearch, 2 research only, 3 sliders only, anything else neither. **A country nobody plays keeps the constructor's 1 and 1.** Each new minister is enabled through slot 52 at once. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ai.md and reversing/findings/FINDINGS-ministers.md section A. **Seen on the running game** (2026-11-16, FINDINGS-liveread.md section 106): loading Ireland1941_07_16_07 drew 505 times on the AI's generator before the first ProcessAI - the placeholder country `---` first, then the list in order, five a country (the played Ireland none, delegating nothing) - and every value is the generator's seeded 5 taken in the order foreign, production, espionage, tech, politics, % 3 + 1 but the espionage minister's % 10 + 1.
addresses.evidence: The load's 505 logged draws (index 0-504) by caller, index mod 5: 0 and 1 at 0x49D5DE (CAIForeignMinister::Enable, the production minister's too), 2 at 0x49CDAE (CAIEspionageMinister::Enable), 3 at 0x4AE960 (CAITechMinister::Enable), 4 at 0x4A1A1B (CAIPoliticsMinister::Enable), 101 each; all 510 values to entering's last reproduced by a Python port of MT19937Seed, the twist and the tempering seeded 5.
addresses.revises: comment - the load's draws seen in this order

struct_fields.name: ai_generator
struct_fields.comment: **The AI's MT19937** - 624 words, with its index at +0x9C0 from here, i.e. CGameState +0xAE4 (the field recorded as ai_draws). Drawn by CCurrentGameState_GetAIRand (Lua GetAIRand), CAIPoliticsMinister::Enable, CAIIntel, ExecuteDiploDecisions' scope seed, the hourly AI trade roll and the wolfpack chooser - never reseeded hourly the way g_random_seed is. **Seen drawing on the running game, 2026-11-15** (every MT19937Next entry with this state logged for 48 hours of July 1941, FINDINGS-liveread.md section 103): CCurrentGameState_GetAIRand, CAIForeignMinister::ExecuteDiploDecisions, **CAIForeignMinister::AnswerPendingOffers and CEU3AI_RankInvasionAreas**, and CCountry::RunHourlyAITrade's two rolls; every draw but the trade's inside a country's ProcessAI, on the thread that runs it. The index moved by exactly the draws logged in 23 of 25 hours, the other two by one more. **Seeded once, at start-up**: CGameState::CGameState calls MT19937Seed (0x27D733, ecx = this + 0x124) with the platform clock's seconds (g_PlatformClock slot 5, CHighPerfWinClock::GetSeconds, the seconds since launch) truncated toward nought by fistp under a control word with rounding 0xC00, then zeroes the index (+0xAE4, 0x27D73D). No save of those checked holds `ai_seed`, the one key that seeds it again, so after a load the AI's draws hang on how many whole seconds the process had run when the game state was made: 5 in four recordings of 2026-11-15/16 (FINDINGS-liveread.md section 106), found as the seed whose once-twisted words are the first hour's dump.
struct_fields.evidence: Listing 0x27D705-0x27D73D: mov ecx,[0x16857E4] (g_PlatformClock); call [vftable+0x14]; fnstcw; or eax,0xC00; fldcw; fistp qword [ebp-0x1C]; mov eax,[ebp-0x1C]; lea ecx,[ebx+0x124]; call 0x6A2BF0 (MT19937Seed); mov [ebx+0xAE4],edi. FINDINGS-savegame.md: ai_seed absent from all saves checked; Ireland1941_07_16_07 and Ireland1939_09_06_18 hold none.
struct_fields.revises: comment - how and when the generator is seeded
